requirements.text: Students must be able to personalise their timetables by colour-coding modules, hiding cancelled classes, and adding personal study blocks.
The system must send automated grade notifications within five minutes of a grade being posted for enrolled modules.
The system must send reminders for assignment deadlines and exam dates, with notifications sent one week and one day before due dates.
Students must have the flexibility to choose how they receive notifications (email, SMS, in-app).
A structured module feedback system must prompt students for feedback after teaching periods, covering content quality, teaching effectiveness, and resources.
Feedback must remain anonymous, and module coordinators can only access it after grades are submitted to avoid bias.
The system must ensure integration with the existing portal without disrupting current functionality.
